description.zh: 把 USB 移动硬盘通过 SMB 共享到局域网，并可作为 macOS 时间机器备份目标（fruit 模块）。
description.en: Share a USB drive over SMB to the LAN, and serve it as a macOS Time Machine target via the fruit VFS module.

desc.zh: 共享目录（挂载移动硬盘后的路径）
desc.en: Share directory (mount point of the USB drive)

desc.zh: 启用 Time Machine 备份
插入 USB 存储时自动挂载（排除系统盘，归 pb-disk 组）。默认开启，插上即用，无需手动。
desc.en: Auto-mount USB storage on plug-in (excludes the system disk, owned by pb-disk). ON by default: plug in and it appears, no manual step.

desc.zh: 隐藏小主机自身磁盘：禁用 Samba [homes] 家目录共享，避免误删系统文件。默认开启，仅保留移动硬盘的 PrintBoxShare。
desc.en: Hide the host's own disk: disable Samba's [homes] home-directory share to avoid accidental deletion of system files. ON by default; only the USB PrintBoxShare remains.

desc.zh: 共享归属账户（SMB 强制落地账户，留空=首个 pb-disk 成员）。磁盘读写权限由 pb-disk 组控制。
desc.en: Share owner (SMB forced account; blank = first pb-disk member). Disk read/write is controlled by the pb-disk group.
